sources.result: Exact residual-state transposition stabilizers can identify interchangeable legal moves. Prototype tested only transpositions that leave support and both residual antichains unchanged; it explicitly did not discover arbitrary larger-cycle symmetries.
sources.current_distinction: q_Sigma identifies different q_o states related by arbitrary full-column permutation and transports actions; it does not require the permutation to stabilize the current q_o state.

sources.result: Candidate rank-local state (support,H0,H1) where H0/H1 are physical winning-line hit masks; direct line-incidence OR updates and exact transition/bisimulation argument.
sources.derivation: Given support S and hit masks, P0 viable lines are L\H1 and P1 viable lines L\H0; subtract occupied support cells from each viable line and antichain-normalize to derive q_o. Therefore q_o <= Q_hit in the rank-local information order.
sources.strict_finite_evidence: Historical complete 4x4: Q_hit=42,168 signatures; current complete 4x4 q_o=34,094 classes. Thus Q_hit is strictly finer on this control.
sources.current_role: Useful direct algebra/evaluator factorization and provenance-preserving representation, but not a minimal-Q candidate relative to q_o.

novelty_guard: Do not describe residual symmetry or line-hit representation as newly invented. Current potentially new content is the full transported S_W orbit quotient of q_o, its symbolic equivariance theorem candidate, and its composition with rank-local safe-forgetting operators.
